select t.task_id as taskId, t.billing_id as billingId, t.request_id as requestId, t.user_id as userId, ifnull(nullif(u.user_name, ''), concat('用户#', t.user_id)) as username, t.key_id as keyId, k.key_name as keyName, b.amount as amount, b.wallet_reserved_amount as walletReservedAmount, b.subscription_reserved_amount as subscriptionReservedAmount, b.key_reserved_amount as keyReservedAmount, t.retry_count as retryCount, t.error_message as errorMessage, t.update_time as failedTime from ai_billing_settlement_task t left join ai_billing_record b on b.billing_id = t.billing_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = t.user_id left join ai_apikey k on k.key_id = t.key_id where t.status = 'failed' and b.status in ('reserved', 'pending_settlement')
and t.request_id like concat('%', #{requestId}, '%')
and u.user_name like concat('%', #{username}, '%')
order by t.update_time desc, t.task_id desc
select count(*) from ai_billing_settlement_task where status = 'failed'
